name: com.theworststudio.playtestnotes
description: Capture in-game feedback while playing: one button pauses the game, takes a clean screenshot and records a voice note with the scene, position, camera and game state. Notes are saved as folders with an index.md meant to be handed to Claude. Compiled out of release builds.

samples.description: A drop-in Playtest Notes prefab and a demo scene with a walking target and a metadata provider.
